paragraphs.text: Edit HTML files visually with TinyMCE in the DeepSeek Harness Better Sidebar.
# TinyMCE HTML Editor for DeepSeek Harness
**Edit `.html` and `.htm` files visually with TinyMCE inside the DeepSeek Harness Better Sidebar.**

Open an HTML file from the file tree (or from an agent file link) and it opens in a
WYSIWYG editor i

nstead of the plain code editor. Edits save back to disk with
conflict detection, while the document

's doctype, `<head>`, scripts and comments
are preserved byte-for-byte.

- **Category:** UI & Experience
- **License:** MIT
- **DSH:** `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`
- **Requires:** `dsh-b
etter-sidebar` `>= 0.28.0`
## What you get

- TinyMCE 6 WYSIWYG editing of the document body, with a toolbar tuned for the
narrow sidebar: histo

ry, blocks/headings, inline formatting, colors, lists,
alignment, links, images, tables, media, and

a source-code dialog.
- **Preview** (rendered page) and **Fullscreen** buttons from the OSS plugins.

- **Save** button and `Ctrl`/`Cmd`+`S`, with dirty indicator and save states.
- Disk-conflict detec

tion: if the file changed on disk after it was opened, the
save is refused and a **Reload** action i

s offered instead of clobbering it.
- Head `<style>` blocks are replayed in the editing surface so t

he WYSIWYG view
resembles the real page.
- English and Chinese UI strings; the viewer can be disable

d from the sidebar's
Side card settings page like any other file viewer.

### From the DSH UI or a local checkout
Use **Settings → Plugins → Install bundle**, or:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Either way the bundle inserts one Loader row, `tinymce-html-editor`. The Better
Sidebar bundle must
already be installed and enabled for the viewer to appear.

After installing into an already-open GUI, refresh the page once if the viewer
does not appear immed

iately: a freshly added client module is picked up by the
live plugin graph, but a page that booted

before the install may still be
running its old module set.

To remove it: `plugin_manager` `remove_bundle` with `dsh-tinymce-html-editor`, or
the Plugins page.
## Compatibility
| Item | Requirement |

| DeepSeek Harness | `>= 0.2.1-rc.2` |
| Better Sidebar | `>= 0.28.0` (the viewer registers through

its `ctx.betterSidebar` service) |
| Host Node.js | `>= 20` |
| Platforms | macOS, Windows, Linux th

rough the DSH web/desktop UI |
| TinyMCE | 6.8.6, vendored (MIT) |

Verified on DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` (desktop, macOS) with Better Sidebar `0.28.0`; the
package's unit tests
and a headless-browser editor/save test pass.
## Permissions and safety

- Reads and writes **local workspace** `.html`/`.htm` files through the Better
Sidebar editor. Saves

carry the file's mtime and are refused if it changed on
disk.
- **No network access at runtime.** T

inyMCE and its skins/plugins are vendored in
this package and served by the plugin's own Host route;

there is no CDN, no
API key, no telemetry, and no external service.
- Serves only the vendored asse

t directory (`GET`/`HEAD`, traversal-guarded).
- No credentials, environment variables, or other fil
e types are accessed.
## Screenshot / demo

The image above is the plugin's TinyMCE editing surface. A safe demo page ships in
`sample.html`; op

en it in the Better Sidebar and try editing,
saving, and reopening it.
## How it works
| Half | File | Responsibility |
| Host | `index.js` | Serves `vendor/tinymce/**` at `/tinymce-editor/vendor/tinymce` (GET/HEAD, MIME

, traversal guard, ETag/304). |
| Client | `client.js` | Registers the `.html`/`.htm` viewer (priori
ty 20, `fsRead`), mounts TinyMCE, splices the edited body back into the original document, saves thr
ough `/sidebar/write`. |
### Body-only editing

TinyMCE 6 removed the `fullpage` plugin, so the viewer never feeds the whole
document to the editor.
It splits the file at the `<body>` / `</body>` tags:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

On save the editor's body HTML is placed back between prefix and suffix, so
doctypes, meta tags, hea

d scripts/styles and comments survive exactly. Body
`<script>`/`<style>` blocks are additionally pas

sed through TinyMCE's `protect`
option so they round-trip unchanged.
Files without a `<body>` tag (fragments/partials) are edited as a whole.
### Saving

Saving uses the sidebar's own `POST /sidebar/write` route with the `mtime` the
file was loaded with.

That keeps the workspace fence and the conflict check in
one place. A `fs-conflict` response become
s the reload banner.
## Limitations

- **Body only.** Content outside `<body>` is preserved but not editable; use the
code editor for hea

d changes.
- **Relative assets.** Relative image/link URLs are kept verbatim on save, but
the editor

canvas resolves them against the Harness page, so relative images
may show as broken while editing.

Absolute URLs and data URLs render normally.
- **TinyMCE normalizes markup** you touch (attribute q

uoting, self-closing tags,
whitespace). Untouched documents round-trip unchanged; edited regions fol

low
TinyMCE's serializer.
- **Better Sidebar is required in this version.** Without it the plugin in

stalls
but registers no viewer. A native document-preview renderer is planned as a
dependency-free f

allback.
- TinyMCE's own UI is English (the plugin's own labels are localized).
